newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks index closes flat ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks index closes flat ahead of weekend.

text.p: Strong demand for food, cement, pharmaceuticals and financial shares partly offset losses by most other shares traded in the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) on Thursday, leaving the index nearly stable, brokers said.
Of 129 traded shares, 34 gained, 91 lost and four were unchanged. Chittagong Cement gained 36 taka to 1,992 while Bangladesh Lamps lost 21 taka to 4,994 and Bata Shoe shed 1.63 to 129.52.
The all-share index at the DSE dropped 5.18 points or 0.46 percent at 1,118.29 on a turnover of 43.1 million taka ahead of the Friday and Saturday weekend.
